About.title: About me
About.p1: I'm a full-stack engineer from Santiago, Dominican Republic, with 8 years of experience between full-time roles and consulting. Most of that time has been spent on the backend: SaaS platforms, payment systems, REST APIs, and the cloud infrastructure that keeps them running. I care a lot about performance, from query tuning to distributed queues, and I like owning systems end to end.
About.p2: I started freelancing as a teenager, and at 17 I left Santiago on my own to study software engineering at INTEC in Santo Domingo, since the degree wasn't offered in my hometown at the time. I've lived alone and paid for my studies with my own work ever since.
About.p3: Away from the keyboard I'm a music guy above all: I play guitar and listen to everything from rock to salsa. I also like to write, watch films, and sit down with a good video game.
